g.text: Finite photon counts fluctuate around exact theory

text.style: fill: #5f6368; font: 8.1px 'Times New Roman', serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Official angles (θ, φ) = (−30°, +30°); independent model streams; reproducible seed 2,026.

text.style: fill: #5f6368; font: 7.2px 'Times New Roman', serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: The 95% Wilson interval estimates a binomial mismatch fraction from one observed count; exact theory itself is not uncertain.

text.style: fill: #202124; font: 700 7px 'Times New Roman', serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Seeded pseudo-random sampling is reproducible for demonstration and is not cryptographically secure.
